Best view but not good food experience
Sep 2025 • Family
The Marina Restaurant has one of the best locations in Da Nang, with a stunning view overlooking the Dragon Bridge—especially beautiful at night when the bridge lights up. It’s the perfect spot if you’re after an unforgettable view while dining.
However, the food did not live up to the setting. The menu looks promising, but the taste and quality fell short of expectations. For the price and the location, I was hoping for something more memorable on the plate to match the view.
If you’re coming here, I’d recommend it mainly for the atmosphere and the view of the Dragon Bridge rather than the food experience.

Worst restaurant in all of Vietnam!
Nov 2024 • Family
Do not go to this restaurant! In a country known for its amazing fresh and tasty food we were shocked by how bad the food at Marina Restaurant was. We decided to try this place after staff on the footpath promised good views of the Dragon bridge and ‘great seafood’. There were multiple red flags- the tired decor, the sad looking waiters, the lack of customers and the menu with ten different cuisines on offer. I ordered ‘scallops with cheese’ as the picture looked like a mornay type dish. I was served these huge rubbery ‘scallops’ ( I question if they were actually scallops or were a manufactured thing like a crab stick) on tomato sauce and mayonnaise… with a droopy bit of salad and bright yellow chunky, tasteless cheese sauce! This dish was so disgusting we couldn’t eat it. The rest of the dishes were unimpressive too, and made us wonder about potential food poisoning , everything felt ‘old’. They even got spring rolls wrong! The waiters were apologetic when we complained about the scallop dish- but I was still being charged 300,000 vnd for that dish when the bill came out ( did I mention that this was also one of the most expensive dinners we’ve had in Vietnam?). The menu item I had ordered was 229,000 and they were charging me 300,000 on the final bill. This place feels like a massive tourist trap, is a rip off and the food is probably the worst I’ve ever had. When we got back to our hotel and looked the restaurant up we found 
many reviews similar to this, all reporting it as over-priced with inedible food, terrible atmosphere and poor service. One star is too much for this restaurant!
